verdict.rationale: Canva supports bulk-style automation via 'Bulk create' with data import, Brand Template autofill/personalization at scale, and Connect APIs/Apps SDK for programmatic batch workflows, which are genuine bulk-operation features for an AI-native/developer user. However, these are separate tools (Bulk create UI, Connect API scripting) rather than a single unified bulk-operation interface, and the MCP server's tools appear oriented to single-design operations rather than explicit multi-item batch calls. missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of MCP or Connect API performing true multi-item bulk operations in one call, rate-limit/throughput documentation for bulk API use, and confirmation Bulk create integrates with the AI-native MCP/agent workflow rather than only the web UI.
